$comment: Base semantic layer — roles that do NOT vary by mode OR theme (type, space, non-themed radii, control/icon sizes, motion). Emitted once under :root. Color neutrals live in modes/; the THEME-tunable roles (brand colors, control/container radius, sticker border width) live in the wiring (tokens/semantic/theme-roles.json) as var() refs to the brand-kit inputs. Those combine via the [data-mode] / [data-theme] cascade.

color.$comment: The only axis-independent color roles: the scrim is a fixed deep dim (used to focus a modal/lightbox), the same in every mode and theme — so the foreground that sits ON it has to be fixed too. Mode/theme neutrals live in modes/ and overrides/.

on-scrim.comment: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

font.$comment: family (display/body/label) is THEME-tunable and lives in the wiring; size/weight/tracking/leading are axis-independent here.

size.$comment: Heading ramp is a 1.25 modular scale rounded to the 4px grid: 48 / 40 / 32 / 24 / 20 / 16.

display.comment: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

h6.comment: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

radius.$comment: control (pills/buttons) and container (cards) are THEME-tunable and live in the wiring; chip/avatar are fixed here.

thin.comment: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

border.$comment: default (the themeable 2px sticker edge) lives in the wiring; thin is the fixed 1px outline of the soft pill — Badge and the Tabs active indicator. Leaf name differs from the border.width.hairline primitive to avoid a flat-namespace collision.

control-compact.comment: 40px — a compact control, for secondary affordances such as a dialog's close button

dialog.$comment: Max width of a modal panel. Leaf names differ from the width.* primitives they alias to avoid a flat-namespace collision.

slider.$comment: A slider is a thin rail with a knob that has to be grabbable: the rail is deliberately slimmer than a switch's track, and the knob larger than the rail is tall, so it reads as sitting ON the rail rather than in it.

switch.$comment: The one control whose proportions are its own: a track twice as wide as it is tall, and a thumb one step smaller so it sits inset rather than flush.

thumb.comment: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

icon.$comment: Icon boxes mirror the TYPE ramp, not the numeric size ramp, and that is deliberate: they are rem-based so a glyph beside a label grows with the reader's font-size preference instead of staying pinned at a pixel count.

sm.comment: 16px — inline with body and control labels

space.$comment: Two families over one primitive ramp: COMPONENT (inset-* / stack / inline) and LAYOUT (layout-*).

shadow.$comment: The lift shadows live on the mode axis (modes/) because they change with the surface underneath. `flat` is axis-independent: it is the absence of one, used by the pressed state to collapse a hover lift. Leaf name differs from the shadow.none primitive it aliases.

flat.comment: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

edge.comment: the resting edge of a raised surface. Flat by default; a theme that wants a sheen sets it (Confetti dark does)

effect.$comment: Leaf name differs from the effect.brightness.none primitive it aliases.

brightness-rest.comment: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

motion.$comment: Leaf names differ from the primitives they alias to avoid a flat-namespace collision.

lift.comment: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

max.comment: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker angle

ambient.comment: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes
constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam
